notes: v0.19.6: Player profiles now provide View all visible groups, opening a searchable, alphabetical, read-only group directory using the signed-in VRChat user-groups endpoint. Group names, short codes, icons, and links to existing group details appear as VRChat permits; hidden memberships remain private. The profile keeps a short five-group preview instead of a 24-row wall. Removed the nonexistent Offline option from the full Status & Presets editor and compact Quest System/phone tools; the underlying status mutation API now rejects Offline. Existing saved Offline presets stay stored but cannot be loaded or applied and can still be deleted. Offline friend counts, filters and truthful offline indicators are unchanged. Quest folder permission, phone Shizuku, Quest System, phone floater, avatar favorites and staff/Relay authorization remain unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployments.
